what: The big button (card) appears upside down (rotateY -180°, 1.1x) 90px below at .2s, flips to the front at 1.6s and settles into place with 1.2s back.out(1.4) — .15s stagger per panel. Restarts from the beginning each time it reaches 75% of the screen, and reverses when scrolling back up.

options.ease: Motion curve, default 0.16,1,0.3,1 — a site curve name (sbCustom) also works
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Panels to flip in (one or more)

from.where: index.html .p-top-btns two red square buttons (Features and Strengths · Company Info). Original addBusinessEvent: y 90 · scale 1.1 · rotateY -180 → autoAlpha .2 · rotateY 0 1.6s customEase · y 0 1.2s back.out(1.4), stagger .15, start top 75%
